# Workspace Query Habits

## Goal
Make the Ultimate Wiki and workspace actually useful through repeatable query habits.

## Query types
- by system/topic
- by workstream/project
- by object/concept
- by source family
- by freshness
- by canon vs chronicle vs operations

## Useful patterns
- ask for current truth first
- then ask for recent chronicle
- then ask for related legacy/import pages
- prefer mixed answers instead of single isolated notes

## Example asks
- current gateway/auth truth
- all pages about Discord/OpenClaw loop
- recent chronicle touching vault recovery
- canon plus recent reality for host bindings
